CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fan_daily_activity (
    fan_registry TEXT,
    activity_date DATE,
    total_chat_messages BIGINT DEFAULT 0,
    total_gifts BIGINT DEFAULT 0,
    total_gift_value_usd REAL DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (fan_registry, activity_date)
);

INSERT INTO fan_daily_activity (fan_registry, activity_date, total_chat_messages, total_gifts, total_gift_value_usd)
SELECT 
    i.interact_fan_pivot AS fan_registry,
    CAST(i.time_mark AS DATE) AS activity_date,
    COALESCE(SUM((i.chat_activity->>'Chat_Msg')::BIGINT), 0) AS total_chat_messages,
    COALESCE(SUM((i.gift_metrics->>'Gift_Tot')::BIGINT), 0) AS total_gifts,
    COALESCE(SUM((i.gift_metrics->>'Gift_Val_Usd')::REAL), 0) AS total_gift_value_usd
FROM interactions i
WHERE CAST(i.time_mark AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE
GROUP BY i.interact_fan_pivot, CAST(i.time_mark AS DATE)
ON CONFLICT (fan_registry, activity_date) 
DO UPDATE SET
    total_chat_messages = fan_daily_activity.total_chat_messages + EXCLUDED.total_chat_messages,
    total_gifts = fan_daily_activity.total_gifts + EXCLUDED.total_gifts,
    total_gift_value_usd = fan_daily_activity.total_gift_value_usd + EXCLUDED.total_gift_value_usd;
